title: Nourishing Dense American Russet Potato Casserole
description: A malty, dense, and nourishing American dish featuring russet potato, nimono-simmer, and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
In a separate pot, bring the vegetable broth to a simmer.
Add the sliced potatoes to the pot and cook until they are slightly tender, about 10 minutes.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange a layer of potatoes.
Sprinkle a third of the shredded cheese, malted milk powder, salt, and pepper over the potatoes.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
